body.x: The structured approach every CS applies when serving a VIP player on Livechat.

head: Pillar
Principle
rows: Communication
Friendly, natural Livechat style that builds rapport
Bonus Management
Strategic use of Angpao, Free Credit and Reload offers
Retention
Soft skills that keep VIP players engaged and loyal
Complaints
Smart, empathetic handling of requests and issues

x: **Ask for the UID or username.** Always start here, even with returning players. Sample: "Hi boss, boleh bagi UID atau username? Saya check account boss dulu."
**Pull up the player profile.** Open the full account in the back office before writing any reply.
**Assess before you respond.** Use what you find to choose the approach, tone and offer.
**Check the player's P&L.** Whether they are up or down shapes how you empathise and what you offer.

body.x: 4. What to Check in the Player Profile

head: Check
What it tells you
How it affects your reply
rows: VIP tier (T3 or TV)
Which bonuses and credit amounts apply
T3 = 3% Secret Wallet (Grace Period capped at SW x 20%). TV = 5% Secret Wallet, eligible for higher Free Credit / Angpao tiers
Last deposit time
Whether the player has gone quiet
Recent deposit = active; long gap = retention concern. Shapes reload and re-engagement offers
Weekly deposit and loss
How much they deposited and lost this week
Drives bonus eligibility and the Angpao / Free Credit / Reload decision
Player P&L (win / loss)
Whether they are up or down overall
Shapes empathy and the offer

x: VIP players drive high deposits and long-term value. Good CS communication raises deposits, improves retention, cuts complaints and builds lasting relationships.
CS is not just support. CS is a retention engine.

Chinese-speaking VIPs with no Chinese-speaking CS free: use ChatGPT to translate, or politely ask whether English or Malay is fine. Transfer complex cases to a Chinese-speaking CS when one is available.
